sections.title: Example 1: Basic AdaBoost with Decision Trees
sections.body:
```python
print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("Example 1: Basic AdaBoost with Decision Trees")
print("=" * 80)

# AdaBoost with decision trees as weak learners
ada_basic = AdaBoostClassifier(
    base_estimator=DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=3),
    n_estimators=100,
    learning_rate=1.0,
    random_state=42,
)

ada_basic.fit(X_train, y_train)
y_pred = ada_basic.predict(X_test)

print("Basic AdaBoost Results:")
print(f"Accuracy: {accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred):.4f}")
print(f"Precision: {precision_score(y_test, y_pred):.4f}")
print(f"Recall: {recall_score(y_test, y_pred):.4f}")
print(f"F1-Score: {f1_score(y_test, y_pred):.4f}")

# Feature importance
feature_importance = ada_basic.feature_importances_
print(f"\nTop 10 Feature Importance:")
top_features = np.argsort(feature_importance)[-10:]
for i, feature_idx in enumerate(top_features):
    print(f"Feature {feature_idx:2d}: {feature_importance[feature_idx]:.4f}")
```

sections.title: Example 2: AdaBoost with Different Weak Learners
sections.body:
```python
print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("Example 2: AdaBoost with Different Weak Learners")
print("=" * 80)

from sklearn.svm import SVC
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression

# AdaBoost with different base estimators
estimators = {
    "Decision Tree (max_depth=1)": DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=1),
    "Decision Tree (max_depth=3)": DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=3),
    "Decision Tree (max_depth=5)": DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=5),
    "Linear SVM": SVC(kernel="linear", probability=True, random_state=42),
    "Logistic Regression": LogisticRegression(random_state=42),
}

print("AdaBoost with Different Weak Learners:")
print("-" * 60)
print(f"{'Weak Learner':<25s} {'Accuracy':<10s} {'F1-Score':<10s}")
print("-" * 60)

for name, estimator in estimators.items():
    ada_model = AdaBoostClassifier(
        base_estimator=estimator, n_estimators=50, learning_rate=1.0, random_state=42
    )

    ada_model.fit(X_train, y_train)
    y_pred = ada_model.predict(X_test)

    accuracy = accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred)
    f1 = f1_score(y_test, y_pred)

    print(f"{name:<25s} {accuracy:<10.4f} {f1:<10.4f}")
```

sections.title: Example 3: AdaBoost Learning Rate Analysis
sections.body:
```python
print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("Example 3: AdaBoost Learning Rate Analysis")
print("=" * 80)

learning_rates = [0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0]

print("AdaBoost with Different Learning Rates:")
print("-" * 60)
print(f"{'Learning Rate':<15s} {'Accuracy':<10s} {'F1-Score':<10s} {'Iterations':<10s}")
print("-" * 60)

for lr in learning_rates:
    ada_lr = AdaBoostClassifier(
        base_estimator=DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=3),
        n_estimators=100,
        learning_rate=lr,
        random_state=42,
    )

    ada_lr.fit(X_train, y_train)
    y_pred = ada_lr.predict(X_test)

    accuracy = accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred)
    f1 = f1_score(y_test, y_pred)

    print(f"{lr:<15.1f} {accuracy:<10.4f} {f1:<10.4f} {len(ada_lr.estimators_):<10d}")
```

sections.title: Example 4: AdaBoost Error Analysis
sections.body:
```python
print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("Example 4: AdaBoost Error Analysis")
print("=" * 80)

# AdaBoost with error tracking
ada_error = AdaBoostClassifier(
    base_estimator=DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=3),
    n_estimators=100,
    learning_rate=1.0,
    random_state=42,
)

ada_error.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Analyze errors at each iteration
print("AdaBoost Error Analysis:")
print("-" * 50)

# Get errors for each estimator
estimator_errors = ada_error.estimator_errors_
estimator_weights = ada_error.estimator_weights_

print("First 10 iterations:")
print(f"{'Iteration':<10s} {'Error':<10s} {'Weight':<10s}")
print("-" * 30)

for i in range(min(10, len(estimator_errors))):
    print(f"{i+1:<10d} {estimator_errors[i]:<10.4f} {estimator_weights[i]:<10.4f}")

print(f"\nAverage error: {np.mean(estimator_errors):.4f}")
print(f"Average weight: {np.mean(estimator_weights):.4f}")
```

sections.title: Example 5: AdaBoost vs Single Weak Learner
sections.body:
```python
print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("Example 5: AdaBoost vs Single Weak Learner")
print("=" * 80)

# Single decision tree
single_tree = DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=3, random_state=42)
single_tree.fit(X_train, y_train)
y_pred_single = single_tree.predict(X_test)

# AdaBoost ensemble
ada_ensemble = AdaBoostClassifier(
    base_estimator=DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=3),
    n_estimators=100,
    learning_rate=1.0,
    random_state=42,
)
ada_ensemble.fit(X_train, y_train)
y_pred_ensemble = ada_ensemble.predict(X_test)

print("Comparison: Single Weak Learner vs AdaBoost Ensemble")
print("-" * 60)
print(
    f"{'Model':<25s} {'Accuracy':<10s} {'Precision':<10s} {'Recall':<10s} {'F1':<10s}"
)
print("-" * 60)

print(
    f"{'Single Decision Tree':<25s} "
    f"{accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred_single):<10.4f} "
    f"{precision_score(y_test, y_pred_single):<10.4f} "
    f"{recall_score(y_test, y_pred_single):<10.4f} "
    f"{f1_score(y_test, y_pred_single):<10.4f}"
)

print(
    f"{'AdaBoost Ensemble':<25s} "
    f"{accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred_ensemble):<10.4f} "
    f"{precision_score(y_test, y_pred_ensemble):<10.4f} "
    f"{recall_score(y_test, y_pred_ensemble):<10.4f} "
    f"{f1_score(y_test, y_pred_ensemble):<10.4f}"
)
```

sections.title: Example 6: AdaBoost Cross-Validation
sections.body:
```python
print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("Example 6: AdaBoost Cross-Validation")
print("=" * 80)

ada_cv = AdaBoostClassifier(
    base_estimator=DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=3),
    n_estimators=100,
    learning_rate=1.0,
    random_state=42,
)

# Cross-validation
cv_scores = cross_val_score(ada_cv, X_train, y_train, cv=5, scoring="f1")
print(f"Cross-Validation F1 Scores: {cv_scores}")
print(f"Mean CV F1: {cv_scores.mean():.4f} (+/- {cv_scores.std() * 2:.4f})")
```

sections.title: Example 7: AdaBoost Mathematical Analysis
sections.body:
```python
print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("Example 7: AdaBoost Mathematical Analysis")
print("=" * 80)

# Demonstrate AdaBoost algorithm steps
print("AdaBoost Algorithm Analysis:")
print("-" * 40)

# Get the first few iterations
for i in range(min(5, len(ada_error.estimators_))):
    print(f"\nIteration {i+1}:")
    print(f"  Error: {estimator_errors[i]:.4f}")
    print(f"  Weight: {estimator_weights[i]:.4f}")
    print(
        f"  Alpha: {0.5 * np.log((1 - estimator_errors[i]) / estimator_errors[i]):.4f}"
    )
```

sections.title: Example 8: AdaBoost Model Persistence
sections.body:
```python
print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("Example 8: AdaBoost Model Persistence")
print("=" * 80)

# Save model
joblib.dump(ada_ensemble, "models/adaboost_detailed_example.pkl")
print("Model saved to: models/adaboost_detailed_example.pkl")

# Load model
loaded_model = joblib.load("models/adaboost_detailed_example.pkl")
y_pred_loaded = loaded_model.predict(X_test)

print("Loaded model results:")
print(f"Accuracy: {accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred_loaded):.4f}")
print(f"F1-Score: {f1_score(y_test, y_pred_loaded):.4f}")

# Summary
print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("ADABOOST DETAILED EXAMPLE - SUMMARY")
print("=" * 80)

print("\nKey AdaBoost Features Demonstrated:")
print("1. Basic implementation with decision trees")
print("2. Different weak learners (trees, SVM, logistic regression)")
print("3. Learning rate analysis")
print("4. Error analysis and weight calculation")
print("5. Comparison with single weak learner")
print("6. Cross-validation for robust evaluation")
print("7. Mathematical foundation analysis")
print("8. Model persistence and loading")

print("\nAdaBoost Algorithm Steps:")
print("1. Initialize weights: w_i = 1/N for all i")
print("2. For each iteration t:")
print("   - Train weak learner on weighted data")
print("   - Calculate error: ε_t = Σᵢ w_i I(y_i ≠ h_t(x_i))")
print("   - Calculate weight: α_t = 0.5 * ln((1-ε_t)/ε_t)")
print("   - Update weights: w_i = w_i * exp(α_t * I(y_i ≠ h_t(x_i)))")
print("   - Normalize weights")
print("3. Final prediction: H(x) = sign(Σₜ α_t * h_t(x))")

print("\nAdaBoost Advantages:")
print("- Simple and interpretable")
print("- Good theoretical guarantees")
print("- Reduces bias and variance")
print("- Works well with weak learners")
print("- Provides feature importance")

print("\nAdaBoost Disadvantages:")
print("- Sensitive to noise and outliers")
print("- Can overfit with too many iterations")
print("- Requires careful tuning of learning rate")
print("- Sequential training (not parallelizable)")

print("\nAdaBoost Best Practices:")
print("- Use simple weak learners (stumps or shallow trees)")
print("- Tune learning_rate carefully (usually 0.1 to 1.0)")
print("- Monitor training vs validation error")
print("- Use cross-validation for robust evaluation")
print("- Consider early stopping to prevent overfitting")

print("\nAdaBoost Complete! 🎉")
```
